text:
maria: Starting a focused thread to draft the customer-contract acceptance criteria for the routing lanes + multi-region tenancy + isolation initiative (Q3+). Need short, actionable items.
kevin: We need a contract checklist: SLA per lane, SLA credits table, degradation/fallback guarantee, and a documented MTTR for critical lanes. Recommend: fast lane p99<=120ms, backed lane p99<=260ms.
sanjay: Add cost-impact appendix: for small/medium/large model families show infra multiplier and a monthly delta estimate. Also include an ops uplift estimate (FTE months) for hard-slice commitments.
lisa: From sales: customers ask for explicit residency wording (country-level), VPC peering SLAs, and audit-log retention durations. We should produce a one-page contract-friendly summary.
noah: Runtime notes: policy DSL needs to express region-preference, primary/secondary model chains, and an explicit "grace migration" state. Example snippet:```policy lane:premium select: region==eu || region==us-east slo:p99<=120ms fallback:[lane:standard] migrate_grace:12h canary:{pct:3 dur:10m}```
emma: Telemetry: propose an "isolation_risk" signal (0-1) used in the contract appendix. Components: tail-latency volatility, cache-warmup-size, error-spike frequency. Map risk bands to recommended contract language.
arjun: Ops: define billing treatment for migration grace windows and a kill-switch SLA. Also need a runbook pointer for customer-requested evictions.
maria: Draft launch gates for contract readiness: 1) SLA matrix and credits table, 2) policy DSL v1 + examples, 3) "isolation_risk" computed for pilots, 4) billing rules for grace window, 5) customer one-pager & legal-approved wording.
kevin: I'll draft SLA/credits table and the MTTR acceptance language.
sanjay: I'll produce cost multipliers + FTE uplift and attach small/med/large model examples.
lisa: I'll produce the customer one-pager and coordinate with legal for residency wording.
noah: I'll publish the DSL RFC with multi-region failover and migrate_grace semantics.
emma: I'll prototype the "isolation_risk" dashboard and run it on 4 pilot tenants.
arjun: Ops will write billing reconciliation rules for grace windows and a kill-switch procedure.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Contract acceptance & lane PRD review" Thu 10:30.
maria: Target: PRD + one-pager ready before Thu meeting. Please flag if any of these are blockers.
kevin: will need runtime capacity numbers from eng-runtime by Wed.
lisa: pinging SEs to collect exact residency/legal asks from customers.
sanjay: including an annex showing sample invoices with grace-window billing.
maria: Great. After PRD review, we'll convert the customer one-pager into a negotiable exhibit for contracts. Thanks all.
